name: rust-faf-mcp
description: RMCP-powered FAF server. 8 tools. Rust-native MCP for IANA-registered .faf format.
long_description:
Rust-native MCP server for FAF (Foundational AI-context Format). Built with rmcp SDK v1.1 and faf-rust-sdk. 8 tools for reading, validating, scoring, and managing .faf project DNA files.

**Tools:** faf_read, faf_validate, faf_score, faf_init, faf_discover, faf_compress, faf_tokens, faf_about

**Why Rust?** Zero-dependency binary. No Node.js, no Python, no runtime. Just the binary.

**91 tests passing. IANA-registered MIME type (application/vnd.faf+yaml).**

tools.name: faf_init
tools.description: Create or enhance a project.faf file

tools.name: faf_git
tools.description: Generate .faf from a GitHub repo URL
